copy.tl: Ang paglalaro ng mga de-koryenteng kagamitan sa loob ng bahay ay hindi ligtas dahil maaari mong masira ang mga ito o ikaw ay mapahamak sa kuryente.
copy.bis: Ang pagdula sa mga de-koryenteng gamit sa sulod sa balay dili luwas tungod kay mahimo nimo kining maguba o ikaw mapahamak sa kuryente.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: donating old toys to younger siblings or others is a form of reuse
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to explain how potential energy stored in lakes and dams in the Philippines is used to produce kinetic energy to generate electricity for use in homes, communities, and industry
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about reusing toys, not about potential energy in lakes/dams or generating electricity. There is no connection to renewable energy or hydroelectric power. The competency is entirely unrelated to the card's topic.

copy.en:
Is donating old toys a way to help the environment?

Yes, donating old toys to younger siblings or others is a form of reuse, because the toys are used again instead of being thrown away.
copy.tl:
Ang pagdo-donate ba ng lumang laruan ay paraan para makatulong sa kapaligiran?

Oo, ang pagdo-donate ng lumang laruan sa mga nakababatang kapatid o iba pa ay isang uri ng reuse, dahil ang mga laruan ay ginagamit muli imbes na itapon.
copy.bis:
Ang pagdonate ba sa daan nga dulaan usa ka paagi aron makatabang sa kinaiyahan?

Oo, ang pagdonate sa daan nga dulaan ngadto sa manghod o sa uban usa ka matang sa reuse, tungod kay ang mga dulaan gamiton pag-usab imbes nga ilabay.

copy.tl: Huwag hawakan ang sugat gamit ang maruming kamay para hindi ito magkaimpeksiyon.
copy.bis: Ayaw hikapa ang samad gamit ang hugaw nga kamot aron dili kini matakdan ug impeksiyon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When a sound source moves away from you, the Doppler effect stretches the sound waves apart, so the frequency drops and you hear a lower pitch.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe using labeled diagrams the biotic and abiotic features of tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the Doppler effect for a receding sound source, a physics concept. G9-L-9 requires describing biotic and abiotic features of specific ecosystems using labeled diagrams. There is no connection to ecosystems, biodiversity, or labeled diagrams.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When a sound source moves away from you, the Doppler effect stretches the sound waves apart, so the frequency drops and you hear a lower pitch.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of the solute and solvent in a solution
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about sound waves and the Doppler effect, not about solutions, solutes, or solvents. G7-M-8 requires identifying the role of solute and solvent in a solution, which is entirely unrelated to this physics content.

copy.en: When a sound source moves away from you, the Doppler effect stretches the sound waves apart, so the frequency drops and you hear a lower pitch.
copy.tl: Kapag ang source ng tunog ay papalayo sa iyo, iniuunat ng Doppler effect ang sound waves, kaya bumababa ang frequency at mas mababang pitch ang iyong naririnig.
copy.bis: Kung ang source sa tingog mopalayo kanimo, ang Doppler effect mag-inat sa sound waves, mao nga moubos ang frequency ug mas ubos nga pitch ang imong madungog.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: 3-D vector diagram symbols are unrelated to plant reproduction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A dot means the arrow is coming out of the page toward you, and a cross means the arrow is going into the page away from you!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: differentiate sexual from asexual reproduction in terms of: a) number of parents involved, and b) similarities of offspring to parents
assignedReviews.reason: Diagram notation has no parent-count or offspring-similarity content.

copy.en:
What do the dot and cross symbols mean in a science diagram?

A dot means the arrow is coming out of the page toward you, and a cross means the arrow is going into the page away from you!
copy.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng simbolong tuldok at ekis sa isang science diagram?

Ang tuldok ay nangangahulugang ang arrow ay lumalabas mula sa pahina papunta sa iyo, at ang ekis ay nangangahulugang ang arrow ay pumapasok sa pahina palayo sa iyo!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang gipasabot sa simbolo nga tuldok ug ekis sa usa ka science diagram?

Ang tuldok nagpasabot nga ang arrow mogawas sa panid padulong kanimo, ug ang ekis nagpasabot nga ang arrow mosulod sa panid palayo kanimo!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: valence electrons
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that matter has (exists in) three states called solids, liquids, and gases
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains electron dot diagrams and valence electrons, which is a chemistry topic unrelated to identifying the three states of matter (solids, liquids, gases).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: valence electrons
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of solids, liquids, and gases in terms of shape and volume (solids: definite shape and volume; liquids: no definite shape, definite volume; gases: no definite shape or volume)
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes valence electrons in dot diagrams, not the shape and volume properties of solids, liquids, and gases.

copy.en: An electron dot diagram uses dots around an element's symbol to show only its valence electrons, making them easy to count.
copy.tl: Ang electron dot diagram ay gumagamit ng mga tuldok sa paligid ng simbolo ng elemento upang ipakita lamang ang valence electrons nito, kaya madali silang bilangin.
copy.bis: Ang electron dot diagram naggamit ug mga tuldok libot sa simbolo sa elemento aron ipakita lamang ang valence electrons, busa sayon sila nga ihap.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a heavier basketball can transfer momentum to a lighter ping-pong ball
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: construct and annotate distance-time graphs and velocity-time graphs to represent uniform and non-uniform acceleration
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes momentum transfer in a double-ball drop, not the construction or annotation of distance-time or velocity-time graphs for uniform/non-uniform acceleration. The competency requires graph-based representation of acceleration, which the card does not address at all.

copy.en: In a double-ball drop, a heavier basketball can transfer momentum to a lighter ping-pong ball, making the small ball fly up much faster than it fell.
copy.tl: Sa double-ball drop, ang mas mabigat na basketball ay maaaring maglipat ng momentum sa mas magaan na ping-pong ball, kaya mas mabilis na lumilipad pataas ang maliit na bola kaysa sa pagbagsak nito.
copy.bis: Sa double-ball drop, ang mas bug-at nga basketball makabalhin og momentum sa mas gaan nga ping-pong ball, busa mas paspas nga molupad pataas ang gamay nga bola kaysa sa pagkahulog niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It shows the distance from one point to another, so you measure the whole object from start to end.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another and on the environment to meet their basic needs
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about measuring distance with a double-headed arrow, not about living things depending on each other or the environment.

copy.en:
What does a double-headed arrow mean when you measure?

It shows the distance from one point to another, so you measure the whole object from start to end.
copy.tl:
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng double-headed arrow kapag nagsusukat?

Ipinapakita nito ang distansya mula sa isang punto papunta sa isa pa, kaya sinusukat mo ang buong bagay mula simula hanggang dulo.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang gipasabot sa double-headed arrow kung magsukod?

Gipakita kini sa gilay-on gikan sa usa ka punto ngadto sa lain, mao nga imong gisukod ang tibuok butang gikan sa sinugdanan hangtod sa tumoy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Double insulation gives an appliance two layers of protective covering
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how light and sound can be harmful to people and make suggestions on how to protect oneself from them
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains electrical double insulation for appliances, which is unrelated to the competency about harmful effects of light and sound and protective measures against them. No instructional support for light or sound harm.

copy.en: Double insulation gives an appliance two layers of protective covering, so live wires inside cannot touch the metal casing even if they come loose.
copy.tl: Ang double insulation ay nagbibigay sa appliance ng dalawang patong ng proteksyon, kaya ang mga live wire sa loob ay hindi makakadikit sa metal casing kahit na maluwag ang mga ito.
copy.bis: Ang double insulation naghatag sa appliance ug duha ka sapaw sa proteksyon, busa ang mga live wire sa sulod dili makahikap sa metal casing bisan pa kon kini mangaluag.

copy.en: Draco is one of the largest constellations, and its name means the dragon.
copy.tl: Ang Draco ay isa sa pinakamalalaking constellation, at ang pangalan nito ay nangangahulugang dragon.
copy.bis: Ang Draco kay usa sa pinakadagko nga constellation, ug ang iyang pangalan nagpasabot ug dragon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: To draw a ray diagram, you need a ruler for accuracy, and you draw the P-F ray and V ray from the head of the object to find where the image forms.

copy.en: To draw a ray diagram, you need a ruler for accuracy, and you draw the P-F ray and V ray from the head of the object to find where the image forms.
copy.tl: Para gumuhit ng ray diagram, kailangan mo ng ruler para sa accuracy, at iguguhit mo ang P-F ray at V ray mula sa head ng object para malaman kung saan nabubuo ang image.
copy.bis: Aron magdrowing ug ray diagram, kinahanglan nimo ug ruler para sa accuracy, ug imong idrowing ang P-F ray ug V ray gikan sa head sa object aron mahibaloan asa maporma ang image.
